scope: Initial BWM factual versus whole-sequence action-swap diagnostic
summary: Matched official/adapted runs completed, but the whole-sequence swap was excluded from action conclusions because it replaced the nine history-aligned EEF states as well as the future.
evidence: Both checkpoints generated all eight factual/swapped rows at seed 42 with identical inference budgets.
Post-launch review showed that eef_abs reads observation.state and the initial metadata swap replaced all 57 rows, creating a history-video mismatch.
lessons: Counterfactual action tests must preserve the complete observed history and alter only a frame-aligned future.
BWM eef_abs is realized absolute EEF state conditioning, not the raw low-level action column.
limitations: The generated videos are diagnostic artifacts and are not eligible for causal action or SOTA claims.
next_actions: Rebase donor future displacements onto the source history endpoint while leaving all history states byte-identical.
